_readme: Session-id prefix (first 8 characters) -> the label build_usage_data.py publishes for that session instead of its own title. The analytics page is public and a session title is free text; a title that should not be published is replaced here. Keyed by session id so the title itself is never written down in this repository. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
